title: City Council District 7
statement: District 7 does not abandon its commercial corridors, but standing with KONO requires rigorous municipal service accountability rather than unvetted fiscal handouts. With KONO sentiment sitting at 0.17 against the city baseline of 0.330 and property crime at 40 alongside 5 recorded incidents, District 7 will stand with KONO by enforcing strict oversight, targeting property security, and ensuring capital projects meet every verifiable standard before funds clear.

payload.text: District 7 signs off on the fire-rated wall inspections and drywall milestone for the Temescal Community Health Center because certified logs confirm structural compliance, while directly addressing KONO distress through targeted municipal service delivery and strict fiscal discipline.
